tools.name: web_meta
tools.description: Everything a page says about itself: title, description, OpenGraph/Twitter card, canonical, favicon, language, RSS/Atom feeds, JSON-LD schema types, headings — and link-preview problems. Use to build link previews, check SEO/social cards, find a site's feeds or structured data. Flags missing og:imag

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: All DNS for a domain — A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA — plus SPF and DMARC parsed and graded, so an agent knows where a domain points and whether its email can be spoofed. Queried live against public resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9). Email grade: SPF present and ending in -all/~all, DMAR

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Who registered a domain and when: registrar, creation/expiry dates, age, days to expiry, status locks, nameservers — or that it looks available to register. Uses RDAP, the registries' official successor to WHOIS (rdap.org bootstrap). A domain with no RDAP record and no DNS is reported as likely avai

tools.name: tls_check
tools.description: A site's TLS certificate: issuer, validity, days until expiry, SANs, protocol, cipher, chain and whether browsers trust it. Live TLS handshake to the host. Flags expired, expiring (< 14 days), untrusted or name-mismatched certificates. Price: $0.001 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-requir

tools.name: http_probe
tools.description: Is a site up and how is it served: status, full redirect chain, timings (DNS/TLS/first byte/total), server, CDN, caching, compression, and a graded security-header check (HSTS, CSP, frame, sniffing…). One real GET from our server. The security grade counts HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Opti

tools.name: robots_check
tools.description: May I crawl this? Checks a URL against the site's robots.txt for any user-agent, lists sitemaps and crawl-delay, and reports which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended…) the site blocks. Standard robots.txt matching (longest match wins, Allow beats Disallow on ties, * and $

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Will this email address work? Syntax, domain MX records, disposable/throwaway provider detection, role address (info@, admin@) and free-mail provider — without sending anything. No SMTP probing (that gets servers blacklisted); the verdict is from syntax, live MX lookup and a maintained list of ~100k

tools.name: wiki
tools.description: Wikipedia in any language: search a topic and get the best article's summary, description, thumbnail and link — or the full article text. Search + REST summary from Wikipedia. full=true returns the article as plain text (sections kept), capped by max_chars. Disambiguation pages are flagged with alte

tools.description: Search arXiv research papers by keywords, author or category — newest or most relevant — with abstracts, authors, dates and PDF links. arXiv's official API. query supports arXiv syntax (ti:, au:, abs:, cat:cs.AI, AND/OR). tools.name: package_info
tools.description: Any npm, PyPI or crates.io package: latest version and release date, license, downloads, maintainers, repo, dependency count, deprecation — to pick or vet a dependency. Straight from each registry (plus npm and pypistats download counts). Flags deprecated packages and ones with no release in 2+ year

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: A GitHub repository at a glance: stars, forks, open issues, last commit, latest release, license, languages, contributors, archived — is it alive and trustworthy? From the GitHub REST API. "activity" summarizes days since last push and last release so an agent can judge whether a project is maintain

tools.name: hn_search
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories and comments by keyword, sorted by relevance or date, filtered by time window and minimum points — what developers are saying about anything. Algolia's official HN search. Returns title, url, points, comment count, author, date and the HN discussion link. Price: $0.001 per

tools.name: doi_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a DOI — or search a paper title — to full citation metadata: title, authors, journal, year, citations count, publisher, license, and a ready-made APA/BibTeX citation. Crossref's open metadata (150M+ works). Search mode returns the top matches for a title/author query. When to use: For citati

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Find books by title, author, subject or ISBN: first published year, editions, ISBNs, page count, ratings, subjects and cover image. Open Library (Internet Archive) catalogue of 30M+ titles. Price: $0.001 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, web_meta, tls_check, http_probe, robots_check, email_check, wiki, arxiv_search, github_repo, hn_search, doi_lookup, book_search · Private data: dns_lookup, domain_whois, email_check · Public sink: dns_lookup, email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read, web_meta, tls_check, http_probe, robots_check, email_check, wiki, arxiv_search, github_repo, hn_search, doi_lookup, book_search · Private data: dns_lookup, domain_whois, email_check · Public sink: dns_lookup, email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
